analysis_spec.cross_validation: leave one of five latent timepoints out; train on all spatial tokens at the other four times
analysis_spec.feature: flatten each 2x2 VAE-latent spatial patch across 16 channels into 64 values
analysis_spec.readout: train-fold standardized ridge regression, intercept, alpha=1; center from positive prediction residual above train target mean
analysis_spec.target: fractional red-mask occupancy in corresponding 16x16 decoded RGB patch

limitations: Single generated clip, prompt, and seed; five correlated within-clip temporal folds are not independent samples.
The red RGB threshold is a proxy from the same generated output, not independent labels or segmentation truth.
A readout result does not establish generalization, object understanding, geometry, contact, causal control, policy efficacy, or milestone completion.
Post-step diffusion latents and predicted-clean x0-hat tensors are different state types and are reported separately.

source_run.source_frame_motion_audit_method: RGB pixels where R > 150, G < 125, and B < 125
